CRM notes / call snippets:
- Customer: mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics + in-app assistant). Wants low-latency chat in product and semantic search across event logs.
- Started on hosted API to move fast; POC validated quality and basic perf. Now moving to Dedicated for predictable throughput and to meet internal security controls.
- Technical: wants VPC access, allowlist CIDR blocks, KMS support for envelope encryption, ability to pin model versions. Prefers batching + prefix/KV caching to hit cost targets.
- SLA asks: 99.95% uptime, 99th percentile token latency targets (customer proposes < 400ms for 8k context; Redwood perf team asked for traffic profile to validate).
- Legal asks: reduce Redwood indemnity cap; DPA retention 90 days with immediate delete-on-request for user PII; EU data residency clause — some EU customers' data must stay in-region.
- Procurement: finance needs committed ARR quote for Dedicated (customer expects $50-150k ARR band). Wants a monthly invoice cadence and clear overage policy.
- Quote: initial Dedicated config estimate provided (4x A100 equiv capacity, autoscale burst) — awaiting final SOW and pricing appendix.
- SE notes: POC highlighted opportunity to enable auto-batching and recommend quantized model variant for non-PII embeddings to reduce cost.
- Customer quote during call: "We can't risk PII in hosted multi-tenant; Dedicated + VPC is the safe path."
- Next: Grace to push MSA redlines to legal (2025-01-15 target), schedule final infra runbook review with Daniel & infra lead (2025-01-20), and supply traffic heatmap to Redwood perf team.
- Risks: Procurement timeline (PO approvals), potential pushback on indemnity/limit of liability, and KMS integration window clashes with target go-live.
- Suggested internal owners: AE Grace (deal owner), SE Daniel (technical), Legal L1 for redlines, Solutions Architect for Dedicated runbook.
